notes.title: Exploring the Abyss has come with many revelations, including some changes and fixes for you all!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/47ec320b22c23a391b568e64ab0efc61f50fb3b3.png"]
Added ‘Enable Cinematic Black’ to the ‘Video Settings' menu, to fix the OLED user experience.
Fixed a bug where different Crouch, Jump and Dash keybindings would reset if you quit to the menu then resumed gameplay.
Fixed motion blur settings so that when enabled, the effect is correctly applied.
Fixed a stability issue on lower specification machines, whilst using DLSS.
Fixed a collision issue in the geometry of Greymont City, where the player could fall out of the world.
Fixed an issue with the statistics tracker for the second health upgrade chest in Weeping Meadows, after the Disconnected Village.
Fixed an issue with the statistics tracker for a mislabeled Drift Crystal at the start of the Drift Mines.
Re-added collision back onto the Drift platform that partially lacks collision, in the Drift Mines.
Fixed an issue where a group of enemies failed to spawn in on the third part of a button puzzle in Weeping Meadows.
Fixed a black screen issue in the Hanging Towers, specifically when using the traversal skip whilst “Reduce Camera Motion” is enabled.
Removed a duplicate Goliath Codex lore entry from the Goliath ability chest, when it’s already a codex pick-up earlier in the level.
Fixed a soft lock in Ruined Field, which occurred when completing the puzzle in a certain order.
Removed a static SFX that played when collecting a Codex lore entry.
Added some collision to prevent the user getting stuck in the Drift Pump level geometry, after collecting the Drift Surge ability.
Added some collision in the Warden’s Drop area to prevent the user walking out of the level on a train, and into an unforgiving void darkness.
Added some collision in Hanging Towers between two walls, to prevent the user from getting stuck and sandwiched.
Fixed a rogue floating barricade in Hanging Towers.
Fixed an issue where if the player tries hard enough, they can get stuck inside a very small cage in a skeleton’s living quarters.
Damage Level and Timer Adjust options now reset to the correct default values for the current difficulty level if “Restore Defaults” button is selected in Story Mode or Scout Mode
Fixed a blocking issue where the Eye of Warden enemy didn’t spawn in if you ran past the Top of Pillar without killing enemies.
Fixed an issue on controllers where you couldn’t proceed through single-option conversations if a direction was pressed.
Fixed DLAA so that it functions correctly.
Custom resolutions now work correctly when DLSS and FSR are turned off.
Steam Deck and PC now use different screen resolution settings to avoid overwriting when using Steam Cloud
Fixed spelling mistake in “ENTRY #2891 - ESSENCE” Codex lore entry.

notes.title: We have released an update for our new demo, with a variety of fixes.

items.text: Please continue reading to see the patch notes!
Luna Abyss Demo v0.2320
Various localisation corrections in French, German, Spanish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
Updated codex formatting across all languages.
Fix for weapon hotkeys not working on AZERTY keyboards.
Removed some unnecessary files from the build package to reduce demo file size.

Thank you so much for diving into our demo! Every piece of feedback we receive is crucial to polishing the final game, and we appreciate every bug report and feedback we have gotten in both our Discord and Steam Forums so far.

releases.displayName: A New Demo Update has Arrived 🌑

notes.title: This demo is a more up-to-date representation of the game, with new added features. Keep reading for a more in-depth look into what’s been changed!

items.text: Luna Abyss Demo Patch Notes
New demo area “Scourge Crater”, which includes a boss fight, new playable level, a new weapon, abilities, and enemies from the depths of the abyss.
"Sorrows Canyon" demo has been shortened slightly to its original length.
Fix to community reported issue for mouse sensitivity slider not functioning as expected.
Updated SFX when navigating through settings menu, as well as improvements to general gameplay SFX.
Additional difficulty settings.
Story mode.
Traversal skip mode, an optional mode for more accessible playing.
Multiple game options and sliders to increase or decrease difficulty.
Multiple game options and sensitivity sliders to customise gameplay experience.
Ultra widescreen support.
The Codex has been updated to include contextual images for each entry.
Controller support for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Switch Pro, Switch 2 Pro controllers.
Added language support for Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean and Russian, in addition to French, German, Spanish and Chinese (Simplified).
For those who have played the old demo, you can enter the new area from the main menu. However, the older content has been improved, so we would recommend you start from there!

We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback on our demo! If you come across any bugs or would like to submit feedback, you can either use the Bug Reports and Feedback sub-forums in our Steam Forums or the dedicated channel we have set up in our Discord!
